qualification.education_qualification: Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant/ MBA (Finance) or officer from IRS/IA&AS/Indian Economic Service, plus qualifying service in the scale of Rs.148800-218600, or 4 years in the scale of Rs.123100-209600, or 20 years' experience in Finance (3 years in a senior financial management assignment).

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant/ MBA (Finance) or officer from IRS/IA&AS/Indian Economic Service; qualifying service and nature of experience as prescribed. Experience required: Serving/Retired Officers of the Central/State Government or PSU under State/Central Government having experience of working on the post in the scale of Rs.148800-218600 on regular basis; or with minimum 4 years' experience on the post in the scale of Rs.123100-209600 on regular basis; or minimum 20 years' experience of working in Finance out of which three years' experience in a senior assignment relating to financial management. Familiarity with Electricity laws, Regulatory affairs and latest development in the power sector. Age limit: Maximum 62 years. Pay: As per Punjab State Electr

salary_details.pay_scale: Staff Consultant/Finance: Rs 1,50,000 per month; Director/Finance: as per PSERC (Appointment & Service conditions of Employees) Regulations, 2015

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed Proforma of Application printed on page 2 of the notice.
Contract applicants send the proforma complete in all respects with self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualification, qualifying service and nature of experience.
Deputation applicants: the parent Department forwards the application with bio-data, ACRs for the last five years and vigilance/disciplinary case information.
Deputation applicants must also send an advance copy in the prescribed proforma themselves.
Applications must reach the Secretary, PSERC by 27-11-2026 (Staff Consultant/Finance) or 28-12-2026 (Director/Finance).
Make sure it reaches by 29 December 2026.
important_instructions: Regulations are available on the Commission's website under the 'Regulations' tab. Deputation applicants must send an advance copy in the prescribed proforma.
